annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "night" on page 452 ("Jaun's Sermon"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within Jaun (Shaun) preaching to the twenty-nine girls, the Ondt and the Gracehoper fable, departure and farewell. During this Age of Men phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349
Troy, Mark L. Mummeries of Resurrection. http://www.rosenlake.net

annotations.annotation_text: Viconian marker "Vico" on page 452 ("Jaun's Sermon"): Giambattista Vico's cyclical philosophy — divine, heroic, and human ages followed by thundering ricorso — structures this passage within Jaun (Shaun) preaching to the twenty-nine girls, the Ondt and the Gracehoper fable, departure and farewell. The current Age of Men phase shapes the language, institutional imagery, and historical echoes of the dream.
sources: Beckett, Samuel. Dante... Bruno. Vico.. Joyce. https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
